title: Independent verification: PR589 family map by exact projector algebra
body:
## Status

Independent verification of one finite PR589 address-operator identity. No new kappa or supplier improvement is claimed.

## Finding

For PR #1351's pinned family `(pair=1, copy=0)`, the child-0 q-perp-plus-coordinate host and six-axis remainder are orthogonal and sum to the rank-14 source projector. In child 7, three disjoint rank-8 hosts and the rank-4 remainder sum to the rank-28 source projector. The verifier checks each exact rational projector, rank, pairwise product, and sum.

For orthogonal projectors P,Q, exact block multiplication gives `D(P)D(Q)=D(P+Q)` for `D(P)=[[I-P,P],[P,I-P]]`. This proves the full 128-dimensional operator identity for both frozen intervals without repeating PR #1351's 128-column replay. It also rejects an omitted helper, a same-rank wrong-axis helper, and a duplicated helper.

This is an explicitly different-method second audit of open PR #1351. It is conditional on that PR's pinned family role map and interval axes; it does not independently regenerate the allocator, establish chronology, replay helper lowering, or admit the supplier.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/bit-family-projector-algebra-seed10/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_BIT_FAMILY_PROJECTOR_ALGEBRA children=0,7 factors=2+4 q_rank=7 controls=3 no_new_kappa`.

Local checks: the verifier, three-control package check, and `scripts/research_package.py --check-only` pass on CPython 3.14.7. Python 3.12 is not installed locally, so the registered Python 3.12 replay wrapper was not run here.
